findings.note: IN House, SB 10 - Culp - 3rd Reading: Bill Passed (roll call 340), 2025-04-01: yea (tally 66–26); census gate: none.

Ballotpedia's roundup lists him as sponsor of HB 1383, Documents and procedures concerning elections. As introduced it updates a voter's registration address when a candidate withdraws, adds electronic sample and provisional ballots to materials given to poll inspectors, and bars giving one person more than one absentee ballot application. The date is the roundup's date, not the bill's filing date. It does not itself set an ID rule.
